ORDINANCE XLIV OF

An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Cotton Control
Ordinance, 1966.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:l(44)/2002, dated
4-11-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--

AMENDMENT)ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIV OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Cotton Control

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:l(44)/2002, dated
4-11-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
W.P Ordinance XX of 1966.--In the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966,
hereinafter referred to as the , said Ordinance. in section 2-
(i) for clause (c), the following
shall be substituted:--
"(c) "bale" means
any pressed package of cotton with standard average net weight of 170
Kilograms, with variation of three per cent plus or minus at 8.5 per cent
moisture content;"
(ii) in clause (d), for the words
"Sindh Cotton Board", the words "Sindh Cotton Control
Board" shall be substituted;
(iii) in clause (k) for the
figure and the words "1st September to 31st August", the figure and
words "1st August to 31st July" shall be substituted;
(iv) for clause (1) the following
shall be substituted:--
"(1) "District
Coordination Officer, Executive District Officer Agriculture, District Officer
Agriculture or Deputy District Officer Agriculture" means the persons
appointed by Government to perform the functions of District Coordination
Officer, Executive District Officer Agriculture, District Officer Agriculture
or Deputy District Officer Agriculture, as the case may be;"
(v) in clause (o), after the word
"Ordinance" the words "to an .owner" shall be added; and
(vi) after clause (r), the
following new clause shall be added:-
"(rr) "owner"
means a person who owns a, factory and includes an allottee, lessee or an
occupier, thereof;".

sections.description:
Amendment of section 7 of WT Ordinance XX of 1966

SINDH COTTON CONTROL (SECOND AMENDMENT)
SINDH COTTON
CONTROL
(SECOND
AMENDMENT)ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIV OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Cotton Control
Ordinance, 1966.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:l(44)/2002, dated
4-11-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
5. Amendment of section 7 of
WT Ordinance XX of 1966.---In the said Ordinance, in section 7--
(i) in subsection (1), before the
full-stop, the following shall be added:--
"Subject to the following
conditions:--
(a) adequate number of raised
"Pucca" platforms;
(b) weigh-bridge;
(c) pre-cleaning machinery like
inclined cleaners, impact cleaners Feather Seed Cleaners, rock catchers;
(d) new sets of gin saws at the
commencement seasons;
(e) post cleaning machinery;
(f) fully automatic press with
the facility of using independent bands of hoops;
(g) use of strong and thick
hundred per cent cotton bales;
(h) proper maintenance and upkeep
of ginning machinery;
(i) availability of technical
staff; and
(j) availability of Pakistan
Cotton Standard Institution (standard grade) boxes for Seed Cotton and lint;
(ii) for subsection (3), the
following shall be substituted:--
"(3) The authority competent
to grant a license under this section may, after giving the owner an
opportunity of being heard, cancel or suspend the license or refuse its
renewal, for such period as it may deem fit on the ground of non-fulfilment of
any conditions prescribed under subsection (1), and for non-payment of any fee
prescribed under clause (i) of subsection (2) of section 30.".

Ordinance, 1966.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:l(44)/2002, dated
4-11-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
7. In the said Ordinance in
section 17 for subsection (1) excluding the proviso add clause (c)
following shall be substituted:--
17(1). Any occupier of a factory
or any other person--
(a) who handles or facilitates
handling cotton in any cloth made of any fiber other than cotton, waters seed
cotton or lint beyond specified limits (more than ten per cent.) or allows any
foreign substance i.e. jute fiber, jute twins, polypropylene bags, human or
anima' hair, confectionery wrappers or gins or presses or allows such cotton to
be ginned or pressed in such factory; or
(b) who in any area specified in
the notification under section 16, gins or presses or allows to be ginned or
pressed any cotton which he knows or has reasons to believe to contain an
admixture of different varieties of cotton,
shall be punishable with
imprisonment which may extend to six months and with fine which shall not be
less than fifteen thousand rupees".
